feed.title: Feed
feed.description: Posts, polls and questions from the community.
feed.empty: No posts yet — write the first one!
feed.guestText: Sign in to post, vote and join the conversation.

welcome.title: Welcome to {name}
welcome.feedIntro: This is the feed: announcements, questions and everything you discuss with each other. Every post can be commented on.
welcome.exampleNote: **This post is an example from Pukalani.** You can delete it from the menu on the post card as soon as you have written your own first post.

categories.coaching: For coaching and consulting the feed works well for short prompts between sessions — and for questions that would otherwise get lost in direct messages.
categories.education: For courses and education the feed is the place for announcements, materials and questions about the subject.
categories.creator: As a creator you announce what is new here, and the comments tell you what your audience actually cares about.
categories.club: For clubs and volunteering that usually means dates, quick arrangements and looking for helping hands.
categories.business: For companies and teams the feed is the calm alternative to a group chat: readable later, sorted, without time pressure.
categories.health: For health and sport the feed suits dates, milestones and questions people would rather ask the group.
categories.craft: For craft and hobby the feed is the place for work in progress, tips and asking how others solved it.
categories.other: Just start: one post, one question, one announcement — the rest follows.

trustLevels.title: Trust levels
trustLevels.description: Members earn levels 1 to 3 themselves — from time spent here, posts of their own, and the upvotes they give and receive. Level 4 is yours to grant: it may retitle and recategorise other people’s topics, pin, close and mark them solved, and edit other people’s posts. Listed here is everyone who has written something in this community.
